title: Kehti Thi Roke Zainab Karbobala ke Ban Me
body:
Kehti thi roke Zainab karb-o-bala ke ban mey, barbaad ghar hua sab karb-o-bala ke ban mey
Bikre padhey hain lashey ansaarey shah-e-dee ke, bachay jawan saare mare gaye hain pyaase, koi nahi hai baakhi juz aabid-e-hazeen ke, har simth hai udaasi lashey padey hai ran mey
Narghey mey zalimaonke tanha khadey the sawar, mazloom beech mey tha the har taraf se pathhar, girne lagey jo zee se sue zamee tadap kar, binte Ali chali hai sue Hussain ran mey
Qaid –e- sitam mey ghut ke masoom chal basi hai, tareek khaid khana har simt be baasi hai, chadar nahi mayassar kaisi yeh bekasi hai, dafna rahe hain Abid ab khoo bhare kafan mai
<<DIVIDER>>
Sajjad ne uthayi har pal nayi musibat, jakda huva badantha aur dhoop ki tamazat, ek jism-e-natawan par duraou ki wo aziyat, aur zauf ki shiddat beemar ke badan mey
Qaidi bana huva tha ibne Ali ka dilbar, ehle haram khade the aghyaar mey khule sar, darbaar-e-Shaam me tha kaisa ajeeb manzar, mushkil khusha ka kunba jakda huva rasan mey
Aankhe bujhi bujhi hain noore nazar kahi hai, turbat jahan hai shah ki Zainab ka dil wahi hai, bete bhi ab nahi hai bhai bhi ab nahi hai, kaise jiye gi aakhir Zainab bhala watan mey
Kunba ye bekasau ka pahuncha watan mey jis dum, ehle watan jama the sab ro rahey the paiham, kohraam chaar su tha barpa sohail us dum, Abid suna rahe the jab dastaan watan mey..
